scores.tell: Cauldron body is matte and fairly flat with gentle form turn, little rim/highlight pop; floor stones slightly textured/realistic.
Soft flat-ish stone with weak form shadow, and the grass and tree shading are painterly and flat. Contact shadows are soft and fine.
Train has realistic metallic sheen and dark bluish shadow. Highlights are small and the form turn is somewhat realistic. The boiler is rather dark.
Same scene as c106 with slightly more banded marble veins. Shading is soft with weak shadow depth.
Smooth gradients, broad soft highlights on the dome, and a clean metallic body. Matches the real cards. The hull highlight is slightly glossy.
Soft rounded keys with gentle bevel highlights and a soft cast shadow. Matches the real cards. The body is slightly flat.
Flat painterly walls with few form shadows. Roof shading is cartoon-like and the light turn is flat and uneven.
Glossy orange rim with a sharp bright highlight, but the broad soft dial shading is close to the real cards.
Rim highlights are sharper and glossier, and the little hot spots on the dial dots look like plastic. A bit too glossy.
Fuzzy matte cat with soft shading but a noisy furry texture and weak highlights. The lit/shadow turn is soft and a little muddy.
